title: Peoples and borders: the Paraguayan War and the War of the Pacific
goal: Read how two wars changed borders and how borders cut through communities, and use aunque to hold an official claim and a messier reality together.

items: Use *aunque* to contrast what a border said with what people did.
Say who fought in the Paraguayan War and when.
Say what Bolivia and Peru lost in the War of the Pacific.
Say why borders did not always match the life of communities.
Use the key words of this lesson: border, highland plateau, loss, line, ocean and Paraguayan.
